"A game in which a nerdy boy runs to catch a bus that keeps going faster and faster. He navigates the streets of Palermo, dodging obstacles such as giant letters, slaps from bullies wearing Palermo FC jerseys, and cyclists. The final boss is Santa Rosalia.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game based on a nerdy boy running through Palermo to catch an accelerating bus, dodging street obstacles and ultimately facing Santa Rosalia.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without clarification questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML Canvas endless runner with keyboard, touch buttons, and swipe controls.
- Chose three health points, increasing speed, distance progress, and a Santa Rosalia boss encounter near the end of the run.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html` and `game.js`.
- Added Palermo street scenery, bus, player, obstacles, HUD, title/game-over/win screens, responsive mobile layout, and persistent best-distance tracking.
- Verified `node --check game.js`; started the game locally and inspected desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.
- Confirmed browser console has no errors after final reload.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page, styling, HUD, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, gameplay logic, inputs, and boss encounter.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; final mobile screenshot was saved to `/tmp/opencode/busetta-mobile-final.jpg`.

content.text: The game is complete in `index.html` and `game.js`. It includes Palermo street scenery, keyboard and touch controls, health and distance tracking, persistent best distance, and a Santa Rosalia boss encounter. Syntax and browser checks passed, including desktop and mobile screenshots. The changes are uncommitted.
